html:
Skill Pages

I think perhaps we should provide the skill name/icon and a table of values for the skills at each level in these categories. Although DR isn't quite like, say Diablo, where the player has to make a choice on what level to have their skills, so I'm not sure if this is necessary. So I posted this here to get others' opinions on the matter (I also posted this in the Warrior category but figured this was was a more appropriate place)

Re: Skill Pages

In lieu of a different system (like a page for each skill with data tables) I put the skill tables for each trainer. It was an easy cut and paste job once the Skill by Class tables were completed.
